# Verity

Open-source TypeScript training framework. SFT, DPO, GRPO. MIT.

Site: https://verity.arjunshah.xyz
Package: veritykit

## Install

pnpm add veritykit

## Train

import { CharTokenizer, createModel, createTrainer, dataset, sft } from 'veritykit'
const text = 'the sea is calm tonight'
const model = createModel(CharTokenizer.fromText(text), { dim: 32, layers: 2, heads: 4, context: 48 })
await createTrainer({ model, method: sft(), epochs: 40 }).fit(dataset([{ prompt: '', target: text }]))

## Methods

sft, prefer, reinforce, jepo, processMethod, mix

## Bridges

execute, match, process, judge, latent, reformulate, compose

## Environments

environment({ name, tasks, bridge, verifier })
rollout(env, policy)
httpPolicy: eval only
mockPolicy: tests
